name: se-web-toolkit
title_zh: 十个前端小工具，从打包到部署一次配齐
tagline_zh: 每次开新项目都要重新翻文档配 webpack、eslint、CI？这包里十个 skill 各管一段。
tagline_en: Tired of re-reading docs to wire up webpack, eslint and CI for every new project? Ten skills each own one slice.
why_zh: 按构建、检查、测试、部署切成十段，每段只解决一类问题，不会一次塞给你一整套脚手架。
why_en: Split into ten slices — build, lint, test, deploy — each solving one class of problem instead of dumping a whole scaffold on you.
limit_zh: 只覆盖前端工程链路，不含后端、数据库和运维；十个 skill 需要你按项目实际技术栈自行挑选启用，全装会和已有配置冲突。
limit_en: Frontend pipeline only — no backend, DB or ops. You pick which of the ten to enable per stack; enabling all will clash with existing config.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Ten frontend skills, from bundling to deploy
